fact: Between June 2023 and August 2024 ten legacy programme MISs (including SAGE, NUSAF3, DRDIP, NSSF) were integrated with the upgraded National Single Registry through APIs or import templates, and the NIRA NIN check API was upgraded.
title: Maintenance of National Single Registry (NSR) Closing Report
